question: Identify the top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highest composition values across all months. For each category, display the time(MM-YYYY), interest name, and the composition value
sql:
WITH max_per_category AS (
    SELECT 
        im.interest_id,
        MAX(im.composition) AS max_composition
    FROM interest_metrics im
    WHERE im.composition IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY im.interest_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        mpc.interest_id,
        mpc.max_composition,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mpc.max_composition DESC) AS rn_desc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mpc.max_composition ASC) AS rn_asc
    FROM max_per_category mpc
),
top_bottom AS (
    SELECT interest_id, max_composition, rn_desc AS rank
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn_desc <= 10
    UNION ALL
    SELECT interest_id, max_composition, rn_asc AS rank
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn_asc <= 10
)
SELECT 
    tb.rank,
    im2.interest_name,
    tb.max_composition,
    im3.month_year AS time
FROM top_bottom tb
JOIN interest_map im2 ON tb.interest_id = im2.id
JOIN interest_metrics im3 ON tb.interest_id = im3.interest_id 
    AND tb.max_composition = im3.composition
WHERE im3.composition IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY tb.max_composition DESC
